name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow with a local dashboard for assigning models to primary, native implementation, fresh review, and explicit opt-in Luna-task roles, with primary-session verification and acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Assign models to named workflow roles, then orchestrate native or opt-in Luna work with verification.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor provides a local, loopback-only model-role dashboard for four named responsibilities: primary orchestration, native implementation, fresh native review, and explicit user-visible Luna tasks. It stores only this plugin's role map and native templates, never configures OpenCodex or another application, and requires an explicit guarded sync before a saved native role is installed into Codex. The primary role keeps architecture, decomposition, verification, corrections, PR authorization, and acceptance; the native lane uses separately installed custom-agent roles, while the opt-in Luna lane creates user-visible tasks through the Codex app task tools (list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread).
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor's configured native lane to build this feature, verify it, and obtain the fresh configured review before completion.
Use the Luna task lane only when I explicitly authorize it; resolve the configured Luna role and keep primary review and acceptance in this task.
